This PKGBUILD is a standard binary package for the dbx-desktop application. It downloads prebuilt .deb files from the official GitHub releases page (https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/releases/) with pinned SHA256 checksums for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures. The package() function uses bsdtar (libarchive) to extract the .deb contents directly into $pkgdir, which is a common and safe practice for binary packages. No suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, eval/base64 usage, or unexpected file operations are present. The dependencies are appropriate for a Tauri/Rust GTK application. This follows normal AUR packaging conventions for prebuilt binaries.
